description.p: Mixamp gives you separate Game and Voice outputs and a single control to balance them. Send your game to Mixamp Game and your chat app to Mixamp Voice in their audio settings. Both play through your system's default audio output.

Move the balance toward Game to lower Voice, or toward Voice to lower Game. Center restores both to full volume. Mixamp remembers your balance between sessions and can keep running with its window closed when you allow background access.
Mixamp requires PipeWire. Game and chat audio must come from separate app outputs for Mixamp to balance them.
Initial release with separate Game and Voice outputs, a saved balance control, background operation, and audio reconnection.
